note: written_at is a number, a manifest-shape defect refused at DD-R01. The refusal must still be recorded: fixture mode writes the whole-manifest record into its temporary outbox, named from the dispatcher's own started_at because the manifest's written_at is unusable (contract section 2.2 as amended).
